walk.reason: Needs your attention, but can be combined across pets — e.g. walking two or more dogs together.

grooming.reason: Needs your full, undivided attention — can't overlap with another pet's task.

enrichment.reason: Needs your full, undivided attention — can't overlap with another pet's task.

feeding.reason: Brief enough to happen for multiple pets in parallel — won't conflict with another pet's task.

medication.reason: Brief enough to happen for multiple pets in parallel — won't conflict with another pet's task.

dog_park.reason: Needs supervision, but multiple dogs can go to the park together at once.

vet_visit.reason: Needs your full presence at the appointment — can't be split across pets unless they share the same visit.

training.reason: Needs focused one-on-one attention to be effective — can't be split across pets.

other.reason: Not a recognized task type — assumed to need your full, undivided attention as a safe default. If you use this often, consider adding a specific type to task_rules.json instead.
